rationale.min_test_r2: Retains useful explanatory power on the chronological holdout.
rationale.max_test_mae: Allows limited library-level variation above the current 368.2 result.
rationale.min_mae_improvement_vs_median_pct: Requires a material improvement over a naive median baseline.

change_policy: Threshold changes require a documented data or business reason; do not lower them only to make a failed model pass.
